newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Smart posts 172 pct rise in subscribers.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Smart posts 172 pct rise in subscribers.

text.p: Smart Communications Inc of the Philippines posted a 172 percent increase in the number of its cellular phone subscribers by end-1996 compared to 1995, the company said on Sunday.

As of end 1996, it had 308,000 subscribers, making it the second largest cellular operator in the country after three years of operation, a company statement said. It did not give comparable figures for 1995.

It said Smart planned to spend nearly 15 billion pesos over the next 24 months in an expansion programme that would more than double the number of its cellular base stations to over 450 from 216 as of the end of last year.
Smart is a joint venture between Metro Pacific Corp, its parent and Hong Kong-listed conglomerate First Pacific Co Ltd and Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) of Japan.
